q: Choose the correct indirect speech: He said, "Alas! I am ruined."
o: He said sorrowfully that he is ruined.
He exclaimed sorrowfully that he was ruined.
He exclaimed that I was ruined.
He asked sorrowfully if he was ruined.
e:
A sentence beginning with 'Alas!' is an exclamatory sentence expressing sorrow. In indirect speech we replace 'said' with 'exclaimed with sorrow' (or 'exclaimed sorrowfully'), drop the interjection and use 'that'. The tense also changes from 'am' to 'was'.
মনে রাখুন:
Alas! → exclaimed sorrowfully
Hurrah! → exclaimed with joy
What a...! → exclaimed that it was a very...

q: He said to his friends, “Let us play now.”
o: He requested to his friends that they should play then
He proposed to his friends that they would play then
He proposed to his friends that they should play then
He proposed to his friends that we should play then
e: “Let us ...” প্রস্তাব, তাই indirect-এ proposed/suggested + that + they should বসে। Us বক্তা ও বন্ধুদের ধরে, সে কারণে we বদলে they হয়। Now বদলে then বসে। সঠিক রূপ: He proposed to his friends that they should play then। Would বসালে অর্থ বদলে যায়, we রাখা person ভুল, আর requested প্রস্তাবের চেয়ে অনুরোধ বোঝায়।

q: Choose the correct indirect speech of the following direct speech: He said, "We are all sinners."
o: He said that all of them were sinners.
All of us are sinners was told by him.
He said that they were sinners.
He said that we are all sinners.
e: Direct speech-এ চিরন্তন সত্য বা অভ্যাসগত বিষয় থাকলে indirect করার সময় reported speech-এর tense বদলায় না। We are all sinners এমন সার্বজনীন সত্য, তাই reporting verb said থাকে, quotation চিহ্ন সরে গিয়ে that বসে, এবং ভেতরের অংশ অপরিবর্তিত থাকে। ফলে He said that we are all sinners শুদ্ধ।
